title: Project click switches tmux pane with background session support
description:
## Feature Request

When clicking on a project in the Projects tab of the Git Worktree Manager TUI:

### Expected Behavior
1. **Switch the LEFT pane** (main working pane) to a new session/pane with the clicked project's directory
2. **Send the old/current session to background** (not kill it)
3. **Highlight the currently active directory** in the projects list
4. **Clicking on a backgrounded project** should bring it back to foreground (swap back)

### Technical Approach
Use tmux commands to manage pane/session switching:
- `break-pane` - Break pane into its own window (background)
- `join-pane` - Join a pane back from another window
- `swap-pane` - Swap two panes
- `send-keys` - Send commands to panes

### Implementation Tasks
1. Add click handler to project items in Projects tab (onMouse event)
2. Track which projects have active background sessions (store pane IDs)
3. Implement tmux pane switching logic:
   - If project has no session: create new pane with `cd <project-dir>`
   - If project has background session: swap/bring to foreground
   - Send current pane to background (don't kill)
4. Visual indicator for:
   - Currently active project (highlighted)
   - Projects with background sessions (different icon/color)
5. Store session state in memory (pane IDs mapped to project paths)

### Files to Modify
- `scripts/worktree-tui.ts` - Add click handlers and tmux integration
- Possibly add a session state manager

### Notes
- The TUI runs in the RIGHT pane (30% width)
- The LEFT pane is the main working area that should be switched
- Need to handle edge cases: pane closed externally, tmux session ended, etc.

title: Merge Projects and Worktrees into hierarchical view
description:
## Feature Request

Merge the Projects and Worktrees tabs into a single hierarchical view where projects are parent nodes and their worktrees are children.

### Current State
- **Projects tab**: Flat list of recent projects
- **Worktrees tab**: Flat list of worktrees for current project only

### Proposed Hierarchy
```
┌─ Projects ──────────────────┐
│ ▼ dot-files (active)        │
│   ├─ main (master)          │
│   ├─ dot-files-3ik          │
│   └─ dot-files-fm4          │
│ ▶ opencode-code             │
│ ▶ another-project           │
└─────────────────────────────┘
```

### Expected Behavior
1. **Projects as expandable nodes** - click to expand/collapse worktrees
2. **Worktrees nested under projects** - show all worktrees for each project
3. **Multi-select worktrees** - Ctrl+click to select multiple worktrees across projects
4. **Open selected worktrees** - creates split pane layout (ties into dot-files-m99)
5. **Active project/worktree highlighted** - show current working directory

### UI Interactions
| Action | Result |
|--------|--------|
| Click project arrow | Expand/collapse worktrees |
| Click project name | Switch to project (main worktree) |
| Click worktree | Switch to that worktree |
| Ctrl+click worktrees | Multi-select for split layout |
| Enter with selection | Open selected in split panes |

### Technical Changes
1. **Merge tabs** - Remove separate Worktrees tab, integrate into Projects
2. **Fetch worktrees per project** - Run `git worktree list` for each project
3. **Cache worktree data** - Avoid repeated git calls
4. **Expand state** - Track which projects are expanded
5. **Selection state** - Track multi-selected worktrees

### Data Structure
```typescript
interface ProjectNode {
  path: string
  name: string
  isExpanded: boolean
  worktrees: Worktree[]
  isActive: boolean  // current project
}

interface Worktree {
  path: string
  branch: string
  commit: string
  isSelected: boolean  // for multi-select
  isActive: boolean    // current worktree
}
```

### Tab Changes
- **Before**: Projects | Worktrees | Files
- **After**: Projects | Files (or: Workspaces | Files)

### Dependencies
- Relates to: dot-files-3ik (project click handling)
- Relates to: dot-files-m99 (multi-select split layouts)
- Relates to: dot-files-fm4 (create worktrees from beads)

### Files to Modify
- `scripts/worktree-tui.ts` - Merge tabs, hierarchical rendering, selection state

title: Create git worktrees from beads issues in Worktrees tab
description:
## Feature Request

Add functionality to the Worktrees tab to create new git worktrees directly from beads issues.

### Expected Behavior
1. **Show open beads issues** in the Worktrees tab (or a sub-section)
2. **Click on an issue** to create a new worktree for it
3. **Auto-generate worktree name** from issue ID (e.g., `dot-files-3ik` → worktree at `../dot-files-3ik/`)
4. **Auto-create branch** named after the issue ID
5. **Visual indicator** showing which issues already have worktrees

### Workflow
1. User sees list of open beads issues in Worktrees tab
2. User clicks on issue `dot-files-3ik`
3. TUI runs: `git worktree add ../dot-files-3ik -b dot-files-3ik`
4. Worktree list refreshes showing new worktree
5. Optionally: switch to the new worktree in left pane

### Technical Approach
- Parse `bd list --status=open` output to get issues
- Parse `git worktree list` to check existing worktrees
- Match issue IDs to worktree paths/branches
- Use `child_process` to run git worktree commands

### UI Layout Options

**Option A: Separate sections**
```
┌─ Worktrees ─────────────────┐
│ Existing Worktrees:         │
│   ▸ master (main)           │
│   ▸ dot-files-abc (feature) │
│                             │
│ Create from Issue:          │
│   ○ dot-files-3ik [feature] │
│   ○ dot-files-m99 [feature] │
│   ○ dot-files-jyz [task]    │
└─────────────────────────────┘
```

**Option B: Merged list with status**
```
┌─ Worktrees ─────────────────┐
│ ● master (active)           │
│ ○ dot-files-3ik [no wt]     │
│ ○ dot-files-m99 [no wt]     │
│ ● dot-files-abc (worktree)  │
└─────────────────────────────┘
```

### Implementation Tasks
1. Add function to fetch open beads issues (`bd list --status=open`)
2. Parse issue list into structured data (id, type, title)
3. Match issues to existing worktrees by branch name
4. Render issues in Worktrees tab with click handlers
5. Implement worktree creation on click:
   - Confirm dialog (optional)
   - Run `git worktree add`
   - Refresh worktree list
6. Visual indicators:
   - Issue has worktree: show as existing worktree
   - Issue has no worktree: show 'create' option
   - Currently active worktree: highlighted

### Files to Modify
- `scripts/worktree-tui.ts` - Add beads integration to Worktrees tab

### Dependencies
- Requires `bd` CLI to be available in PATH

title: Replace colorful emojis with black/white unicode characters
description:
## Task

Replace all colorful emoji icons with monochrome black/white Unicode characters for a cleaner, more consistent terminal appearance.

### Current Emoji Usage

**file-tree.ts (FILE_ICONS map, lines 38-51):**
| Extension | Current Emoji | Unicode Code |
|-----------|---------------|--------------|
| .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx | 📜 | \u{1F4DC} |
| .json | 📋 | \u{1F4CB} |
| .md | 📝 | \u{1F4DD} |
| .lua | 🌙 | \u{1F319} |
| .sh/.zsh | 💻 | \u{1F4BB} |
| .py | 🐍 | \u{1F40D} |
| .rs | ⚙️ | \u{2699}\u{FE0F} |
| .go | 🐹 | \u{1F439} |
| directory | 📁 | \u{1F4C1} |
| default file | 📄 | \u{1F4C4} |

**worktree-tui.ts:**
| Location | Current | Unicode Code |
|----------|---------|--------------|
| Search icon (line 462) | 🔍 | \u{1F50D} |
| Project folder (line 578) | 📁 | \u{1F4C1} |
| Worktree tree (line 611) | 🌳 | \u{1F333} |
| Expand/collapse (line 654) | ▼/▶ | \u{25BC}/\u{25B6} (already B&W) |

### Suggested B&W Unicode Replacements

| Purpose | B&W Unicode | Character |
|---------|-------------|-----------|
| Directory | ▸ or ◆ or ■ | U+25B8, U+25C6, U+25A0 |
| File (default) | ○ or ◇ or □ | U+25CB, U+25C7, U+25A1 |
| Code files | ◈ or ▪ | U+25C8, U+25AA |
| Config/JSON | ◉ or ● | U+25C9, U+25CF |
| Docs/Markdown | ☰ or ≡ | U+2630, U+2261 |
| Script/Shell | ⌘ or ⚡ | U+2318, U+26A1 |
| Search | ⌕ or ◎ | U+2315, U+25CE |
| Tree/Worktree | ⎇ or ⌥ | U+2387, U+2325 |

### Alternative: Nerd Font Icons
If Nerd Fonts are available, could use:
- 󰉋 folder, 󰈙 file, 󰛦 typescript, etc.

### Files to Modify
1. `scripts/components/file-tree.ts` - FILE_ICONS map and getFileIcon()
2. `scripts/worktree-tui.ts` - Search icon, project icon, worktree icon

### Implementation Notes
- Keep ▼/▶ for expand/collapse (already B&W)
- Test in terminal to ensure characters render correctly
- Consider adding a config option to switch between emoji/unicode/nerd-font styles

title: Ctrl+click multiple projects to create split pane layouts
description:
## Feature Request

Extend project selection to support multi-select with Ctrl+click, creating split pane layouts on the left side.

### Expected Behavior
1. **Ctrl+click on projects** to select multiple (2-3 projects)
2. **Visual selection indicator** shows which projects are selected
3. **Press Enter or click 'Open'** to create the split layout
4. **Layout options:**
   - 2 projects: horizontal or vertical split (50/50)
   - 3 projects: one big pane + stack of smaller ones on right (master-stack layout)

### Layout Examples

**2 projects (horizontal):**
```
┌─────────────┬─────────────┐
│             │             │
│  Project A  │  Project B  │
│             │             │
└─────────────┴─────────────┘
```

**3 projects (master-stack):**
```
┌─────────────┬─────────────┐
│             │  Project B  │
│  Project A  ├─────────────┤
│   (main)    │  Project C  │
└─────────────┴─────────────┘
```

### Technical Approach
- Track selected projects in a Set
- Detect Ctrl+click via mouse event (event.ctrl or similar)
- Use tmux commands to create layouts:
  - `split-window -h` / `split-window -v` for splits
  - `select-layout main-vertical` for master-stack
  - `resize-pane` to adjust proportions

### Implementation Tasks
1. Add multi-select state (Set of selected project paths)
2. Handle Ctrl+click to toggle selection
3. Visual indicator for selected projects (checkbox, highlight, border)
4. Action button or Enter key to execute layout
5. Implement tmux layout creation:
   - Calculate pane sizes based on selection count
   - Create panes with correct directories
   - Apply layout (main-vertical for 3+)
6. Clear selection after layout created

### Dependencies
- Depends on: dot-files-3ik (basic project click handling)

### Files to Modify
- `scripts/worktree-tui.ts` - Multi-select state, Ctrl+click handler, layout creation

title: Add file tree explorer to worktree manager TUI
description:
## Overview
Add a file tree explorer panel to the git worktree manager TUI that displays the directory structure of the selected worktree.

## Current State
- TUI has two panels: Recent Projects (40% height) and Worktrees (remaining space)
- Uses @opentui/core components: Box, Text, ScrollBox
- No built-in Tree component in OpenTUI - must build custom

## Implementation Requirements

### 1. Custom Tree Component
Build a collapsible file tree using Box/Text components:
- Indentation-based hierarchy (2 spaces per level)
- Folder icons (closed/open state): `▶` / `▼`
- File icons based on extension (optional)
- Lazy loading for large directories

### 2. Layout Changes
Restructure the TUI layout to accommodate the file tree:
- Option A: Add third panel below worktrees
- Option B: Replace worktrees panel when a worktree is selected
- Option C: Horizontal split - left: projects/worktrees, right: file tree

### 3. File System Integration
- Use Bun.file() and fs APIs to read directory contents
- Respect .gitignore patterns (optional enhancement)
- Handle symlinks appropriately
- Show file sizes and modification dates (optional)

### 4. Data Flow
- File tree should update when:
  - A worktree is selected (future interaction feature)
  - Current working directory changes
- Initially show CWD file tree

## Technical Notes
- OpenTUI uses flexbox (Yoga) for layout
- ScrollBox handles overflow with viewport culling
- Text component supports styled content via template literals

## Out of Scope (for this issue)
- File selection/interaction (separate issue)
- File preview/editing
- Search functionality
